verdict.rationale: Browser Use ships an open-source Python library (github.com/browser-use/browser-use) that runs locally and independently of the Cloud API, explicitly positioned as the option for self-hosted/local agents ("For a local agent, use the open-source library"), and community reports confirm running it locally connected to a real browser/profile. missing for 10: no first-party self-hosting guide covering infra/deployment (e.g. Docker, scaling), and no independent audit of parity between self-hosted and cloud feature sets (stealth, CAPTCHA solving, proxies are cloud-only per docs).
